ios.desc:
Not your average weather app! Poweather is the largest community-based weather app. 
Join other reporters around the world to share live weather conditions!

- Browse weather posted by other people on a map or a list.
- Create questions to ask locals about the actual weather.
- Share weather with over than 40 weather icons, photos, videos and texts.
- Subscribe to location and get real-time notification when weather changes.
- View hourly and daily weather forecast up to 10 days.
- See where the storms are!
- Collect badges of achievement.
- Synchronize your account with Facebook.
- Keep your privacy by posting anonymously.
- Make friends with weather :-)
Join us and post your first weather report!

*Poweather may use your location even when it isn't open, which can decrease battery life.
* Facebook Ads Information: https://m.facebook.com/ads/ad_choices

== Poweather subscription details ==
Payment will be charged to iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.

Subscription will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the current cost of the renewal.

Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's account settings on their iPhone after purchase.

Full terms and conditions can be found at https://www.poweather.com/term-of-use-en/
